novel_features.name: Portfolio concall grep
novel_features.description: Full-text search a phrase across every concall transcript in your portfolio and get the scrip, paragraph, and filing date back.
novel_features.rationale: FTS5 runs over the local concall_chunks table joined to holdings; BSE ships no transcript search at all.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this when an agent needs the exact sentence management used about a theme across many companies, not a 40-page PDF.

novel_features.name: Thesis drift
novel_features.description: Per-quarter frequency of guidance keywords (margin, demand, debt, guidance verbs) across a company's last N concalls, showing which terms are rising or falling.
novel_features.rationale: Mechanical term-frequency counts across concall_chunks grouped by quarter; no API or competitor ships tone drift.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this to detect thesis decay — when management's language shifts before the numbers do.

novel_features.name: Cross-holding phrase sweep
novel_features.description: Find a phrase appearing across two or more holdings in one quarter, grouped by sector — a sector-wide shift detector.
novel_features.rationale: Cross-holding FTS5 join grouped by holdings.sector; aggregators summarize single companies, none diff language across a set.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this when the question is sector-level: which companies all started saying the same thing this quarter.

novel_features.name: Due-soon calendar
novel_features.description: Holdings with results, board meetings, or AGM due in the next N days, merged from two BSE endpoints into one list.
novel_features.rationale: Merges Corpforthresults and DefaultData and filters to your holdings; the BSE site cannot combine them.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use before an earnings week to see every holding with a calendar event coming up.

novel_features.name: Results outcomes (2-wave join)
novel_features.description: Beat/miss tagging for results filings, joining the detailed-financials numbers to the headline outcome filing on quarter.
novel_features.rationale: Joins results_outcomes (TabResults_PAR) to filings on quarter, reconciling the headline + detailed-financials waves no single call returns.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this after a results wave to line up reported numbers against what management said.

novel_features.name: Stale-thesis scan
novel_features.description: Holdings with no filing activity in N days — silence as a signal.
novel_features.rationale: Local MAX(filed_at) per holding vs a threshold; BSE has no "who has been quiet" endpoint.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use to surface holdings that have gone unusually quiet, which can precede a surprise.

novel_features.name: Critical-news watch
novel_features.description: Every holding that filed a Regulation-30 critical-news (material) disclosure in the last N days, in one call.
novel_features.rationale: Portfolio-wide filter on the CRITICALNEWS flag in the local store; BSE forces one scrip at a time.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this for material-disclosure triage across the whole portfolio at once.

novel_features.name: Concall extract
novel_features.description: Fetch, parse, and store a single concall PDF, then print only the paragraphs matching a phrase instead of the whole transcript.
novel_features.rationale: PDF to chunks in SQLite plus a --mentions paragraph filter; returns three paragraphs, not forty pages, saving agent context.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when a bot needs the relevant passage of a call without ingesting the full PDF.

narrative.headline: Mirrors BSE corporate filings into a local SQLite store and answers the cross-holding, tone-drift, and calendar questions the BSE site cannot.
narrative.value_prop: BSE Filings syncs every tracked holding's announcements, results, board meetings, and concall transcripts into a local FTS5 database. It turns eight quarters of concall language into a greppable, drift-detectable signal across an entire portfolio — concall-grep finds a phrase across every holding, thesis-drift shows when management's language is shifting, and due-soon merges two BSE calendars the site keeps apart. Built for IMstockbox Council bots as a subprocess and for an operator at the terminal.
narrative.auth_narrative: No API key or login. BSE's JSON API is reachable with browser Referer and User-Agent headers, which the client sets automatically. If a request 301-redirects to a members page, the headers were stripped — re-run with the bundled client, not a bare curl.

quickstart.comment: see the seeded holding universe (scrip codes) before syncing
pull every filing for every holding since the last cursor into ~/.bse-filings/filings.db
which holdings have results or board meetings in the next week
find the phrase across every synced concall
watch how RELIANCE's guidance language moved over four quarters

troubleshoots.symptom: Command returns empty and you expected filings
troubleshoots.fix: Run `bse-filings-pp-cli sync` first — concall-grep, cross, stale, and sql read the local store, which is empty until sync populates it.

troubleshoots.symptom: Sync returns nothing for a scrip
troubleshoots.fix: Confirm the scrip code with `bse-filings-pp-cli holdings list`; BSE keys on numeric scrip_code, not the ticker symbol.

troubleshoots.symptom: A request 301-redirects to a members page
troubleshoots.fix: The Referer/User-Agent headers were stripped; use the CLI's own client (it sets them) rather than a bare HTTP call.

troubleshoots.symptom: A concall command shows an empty transcript
troubleshoots.fix: That PDF is a scanned image; the parse path flags it as needing OCR and skips it rather than crashing.

narrative.when_to_use: Reach for BSE Filings when an agent or operator needs to ask compound questions across an Indian-equity portfolio that the BSE website answers one company at a time: searching concall transcripts for a phrase, detecting tone drift across quarters, finding sector-wide language shifts, or merging the results and board-meeting calendars. It is the right tool for earnings-season triage and thesis-decay monitoring, not for live quotes or order placement.

recipes.title: Earnings-week triage
recipes.explanation: Lists holdings with a results or board-meeting event in the next seven days, merged from both BSE calendars.

recipes.title: Thesis-decay check before a Council call
recipes.explanation: Shows the per-quarter frequency of guidance terms across TCS's last four concalls so a softening narrative is visible.

recipes.title: Sector-wide language shift
recipes.explanation: Surfaces the same phrase appearing across two or more holdings in the window — an emerging sector theme.

recipes.title: Agent-narrowed announcements feed
recipes.explanation: Returns only the four high-gravity fields per critical filing so an agent does not parse the full record.

recipes.title: Power-user SQL over the mirror
recipes.command: bse-filings-pp-cli sql "SELECT scrip_cd, COUNT(*) AS filings FROM announcements GROUP BY scrip_cd ORDER BY filings DESC"
recipes.explanation: Direct read-only SQLite query against the local filings mirror for ad-hoc aggregation.

trigger_phrases: search BSE concalls for a phrase
what's due this week for my holdings
